info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Product Directory Validation-spec
info.description: The Product Directory Validation API facilitates the validation of product entries within the banking product management system. This endpoint allows for the submission of product validation requests, ensuring that new entries meet the necessary business criteria before being added to the product directory. Financial institutions and product managers commonly utilize this API to maintain compliance and data integrity. It streamlines the onboarding process for financial products, reducing errors and enhancing overall operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint validates the entry for a specific product in the product directory, ensuring all necessary data meets the requirements for further processing.
